svg.title: Black Panel with White Curve III
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; interpretive screen colours. Observed black square at upper left joins a white curved wedge at right. Surrounding top-right and bottom-left spaces remain transparent; depth and shadows omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/black-panel-white-curve-iii; object B-KELLY-2P89.38; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
